meta.name: datapack-builder
meta.description: Build professional financial services data packs from various sources including CIMs, offering memorandums, SEC filings, web search, or MCP servers. Extract, normalize, and standardize financial data into investment committee-ready Excel workbooks with consistent structure, proper formatting, and documented assumptions. Use for M&A due diligence, private equity analysis, investment committee materials, and standardizing financial reporting across portfolio companies. Do not use for simple financial calculations or working with already-completed data packs.

copy.tagline: 从多种来源提取财务数据并生成标准化的 Excel 工作簿。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从 CIM、SEC 文件等来源构建标准化的财务数据包。
